## 2. The playbook (layer 2)

Drafted from `R-2000iC Maintenance Manual` page 4 by the extractive drafter, kind `repair`, approved by `engineer-1`. Each step cites its page.

1. Isolate the cell following the lockout procedure on page 2. *(p. 4)*
2. Remove the belt guard. The guard is held by four M6 bolts torqued to 10 Nm. *(p. 4)*
3. Measure belt deflection at the midpoint of the longest span. Deflection must be 4 to 6 mm under 20 N of applied force. *(p. 4)*
4. If deflection is outside that range, slacken the motor mount bolts and reset tension. Retighten the motor mount bolts to 42 Nm. *(p. 4)*
5. Inspect the fan shroud for accumulated debris and clear it. *(p. 4)*
6. Refit the guard, remove locks, and run the axis for 20 minutes. Confirm the housing temperature settles below 70 degrees Celsius. *(p. 4)*

Tools: torque wrench 5-60 Nm, belt tension gauge, 10 mm socket · estimate 45 min
